purpose: Router-visible replay cases for debugging-policy evaluation.

cases.title: Bug/cg 757/merchant can log in without username and password
cases.symptom: Merchant authentication allowed login without entering username and password.
visible_evidence: Authentication flow issue in merchant login path
Changed files include users auth view plus shared Shopify-related modules
PR title indicates a real production auth bug rather than a test-only defect
success_criteria: propose a fix direction consistent with the merged patch family
cases.notes: PR body was null, so visible context relies mainly on title and changed-file pattern.

cases.title: Bug/cg 942/attribute error when entering ciq path
cases.symptom: An AttributeError occurred when entering the CIQ path.
visible_evidence: Changed files span influencers viewsets, serializers, and shared publishers logic
Merge trail references a Sentry issue, so this looks like a real observed production failure
success_criteria: trace the CIQ path failure to the correct object or attribute boundary
match the fix direction in the merged patch family
cases.notes: Strong replay case because the GitHub trail points to an external incident reference.

cases.title: Bug/cg 940/refreshing orders limit does not work
cases.symptom: Refreshing orders did not apply the expected limit.
visible_evidence: Orders refresh path is ignoring or misapplying a limit
Merge trail references a Sentry issue
success_criteria: find why the refresh limit was not being applied
align with the landed fix behavior
cases.notes: Best compact CreatorGift backend replay to start with.

cases.title: CG-936 Fixed Incorrect value of items and orders limits
cases.symptom: Items and orders limits were calculated or displayed incorrectly.
visible_evidence: Multiple clients, orders, and influencer-side files changed
Bug appears to involve value propagation across tasks, forms, helpers, and signals
This looks broader than a one-line fix and more like a miscomputed or mispropagated limit value
success_criteria: identify where limit values were being miscomputed or mispropagated
produce the same fix family as the merged patch
cases.notes: Broader patch than the others, useful as a harder replay case after the compact ones.

cases.title: [HFC-63] Fixing issue caused by Lead.answers.response field length inconsistency with Recommendation.response
cases.symptom: Model field length mismatch between Lead.answers.response and Recommendation.response caused failures.
visible_evidence: Schema inconsistency between two response fields
Changed files include models, migration, admin, tests, and README
This looks like a clean data-model mismatch rather than a UI or workflow issue
success_criteria: confirm the fix direction through model, migration, and test changes
cases.notes: Best clean non-UI replay case in the set.
